name: google-workspace-gerbidigm
description: Google Workspace MCP integration with Gerbidigm enhancements. Manage Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Calendar, Chat, and People API — including bulk Gmail operations, markdown-to-Docs conversion, and flexible fetch with field masks.
long_description:
A Model Context Protocol server for Google Workspace, extended with Gerbidigm productivity tools.

**Included services:**
- **Gmail** — search, read, send, label, batch-modify, bulk mark-read/unread/trash/inbox, flexible fetch with field masks
- **Google Docs** — read, write, format, insert markdown, manage images, structural editing
- **Google Drive** — search, upload, copy, move, trash, manage folders
- **Google Calendar** — list, create, update, delete events, find free time
- **Google Sheets** — read ranges and metadata
- **Google Slides** — read text, metadata, and thumbnails
- **Google Chat** — list spaces, send messages and DMs
- **People API** — look up contacts and directory

Authentication uses Google OAuth 2.0. On first use, open the `auth` tool to complete the browser-based sign-in flow. Tokens are stored securely in `~/.google-workspace-mcp/`.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Your Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Desktop App type). Required if you see 'This app is blocked' during sign-in. Create one at console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Credentials.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Your Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client Secret, paired with the Client ID above.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API Key (optional)
gemini_api_key.description: Leave blank to use your Google OAuth credentials for Gemini image tools (recommended). Only needed if you prefer a dedicated API key or your Google account does not have Generative Language API access.
